source: 国际金融信息源泉与自动化监测蓝图.pdf
principle: Pulse S0 official sources around release windows, use S1 news for speed, S2 market resonance for validation, and S3 social/alternative data only as budgeted clues.

sectors.name: 全球权益与波动
sectors.impact_path: risk beta, style rotation, leverage and volatility budget
sectors.trigger_hint: SPY/QQQ/VT/EEM 5-minute move above 1.2 sigma with VIX expansion above 8%, or local exchange notice plus local ETF resonance.

sectors.name: 主权利率与央行
sectors.impact_path: discount rate, bank NII, FX, duration-sensitive growth stocks
sectors.trigger_hint: Decision-window polling 30 minutes before and after events; official document plus rates move above 8bp can reach L2/L3.

sectors.name: 外汇与资本流向
sectors.impact_path: cross-asset anchor, EM risk, commodity/import cost, capital-control risk
sectors.trigger_hint: USD/CNH one-day move above 0.7%, DXY above 0.8%, or official reference-price gap above 1 sigma.

sectors.name: 宏观数据与经济日历
sectors.impact_path: macro surprise to rates, FX, equity sector rotation
sectors.trigger_hint: Calendar hit alone is not alert. Upgrade only after release surprise plus price resonance.

sectors.name: 信用与流动性
sectors.impact_path: financial conditions, credit beta, bank stress, tail risk
sectors.trigger_hint: KRE/KBE/XLF down above 3%, HYG/LQD ratio deterioration, or short-end funding rates jump above 20bp.

sectors.name: 商品与能源
sectors.impact_path: inflation, resource earnings, transport costs, policy expectations
sectors.trigger_hint: USO/XLE above 3%, UNG above 5%, GLD above 2%, OVX above 10%, plus EIA or transport disruption evidence.

sectors.name: 监管执法与券商/交易所规则
sectors.impact_path: single-name compliance discount, industry rerating, trading cost and platform risk
sectors.trigger_hint: S0 penalty/rule document starts at L1; material business impact plus price resonance is L2; multi-regulator or Federal Register finalization is L3.

sectors.name: 公司披露与企业行动
sectors.impact_path: single-name event, read-through, capital flow, valuation reset
sectors.trigger_hint: Original filing beats media. Social-only rumor stays L0/L1 until filing or price confirmation.

sectors.name: AI/半导体与出口管制
sectors.impact_path: growth core holdings, supply-chain linkage, geopolitical constraint premium
sectors.trigger_hint: BIS/Federal Register/NIST official item plus direct ticker or supply-chain map can reach L2/L3.

sectors.name: 存储器与数据基础设施周期
sectors.impact_path: DRAM/NAND pricing, HBM capacity, data-center capex, inventory and margin cycle
sectors.trigger_hint: Issuer/industry evidence plus two or more memory/storage names or the semiconductor ETF moving together can reach L2; price alone stays L1.

sectors.name: 黄金与贵金属
sectors.impact_path: real yields, USD, inflation/tail hedge demand, miner operating leverage
sectors.trigger_hint: Require gold ETF/futures resonance and either rates/USD confirmation or official/issuer evidence for L2+.

sectors.name: 美股广度与风格轮动
sectors.impact_path: index concentration, equal-weight breadth, small-cap/rate sensitivity, sector leadership and credit confirmation
sectors.trigger_hint: Use cross-sectional confirmation: cap-weight/equal-weight, small/large, sectors, credit and volatility. One ETF move alone remains L1.

sectors.name: 政府合同/国防航天/频谱
sectors.impact_path: order visibility, backlog, spectrum winners/losers, procurement surprise
sectors.trigger_hint: Original tender/award document outranks press. News without contract or notice id cannot exceed L1.

sectors.name: 物流航运与地缘咽喉
sectors.impact_path: freight rates, energy transport delay, insurance costs, supply-chain disruption
sectors.trigger_hint: Official notice/circular triggers L1. AIS congestion above 2 sigma plus BDRY/SEA/ZIM above 3-5% can reach L2/L3.

cooldowns.revision: send only if revision=true and score remains L2+
cooldowns.portfolio_hit: bypass normal cooldown once, then high-frequency monitor
